# HuntInTown

> HuntInTown, also known as Hunt In Town, is a platform for connecting people who need something with people and businesses that can help.

## About

HuntInTown helps visitors either post a requirement or discover relevant opportunities. It supports local services, professionals, freelancers, businesses, suppliers, skills, products, and work opportunities.

The two primary user journeys are:

- People looking for help can post a requirement and connect with relevant local professionals, service providers, freelancers, businesses, or suppliers.
- People offering help can discover requirements and opportunities that match their skills, services, products, or experience.

## Primary Pages

- [HuntInTown homepage](https://huntintown.com/): Choose whether you need help or can help, then learn how the platform works.
- [Post a requirement](https://huntintown.com/hunter): Find local services, professionals, businesses, freelancers, suppliers, and skilled people for a requirement.
- [Find opportunities](https://huntintown.com/helper): Discover local work, freelance projects, service leads, customer requirements, and business opportunities.
- [About HuntInTown](https://huntintown.com/about): Learn about the platform and its purpose.

## Brand Names
